board.editing_hint: Drag a column by its handle to reorder it. Double-click a name to rename it, or use ⋯ for color, behavior and delete. Changes save right away.

head.rename_title: Double-click or press Enter to rename
head.grip_hint: Press Space to pick the column up, the arrow keys to move it and Space again to drop it. Escape puts it back. {alt} with the left or right arrow moves it one step.

menu.delete_initial: New tasks start here. Make another column the start to delete this one.

rename.label: Column name
rename.empty: A column needs a name. The old one stays.

add.name: New column
add.hint: Press Enter to add it, Escape to cancel.
add.required: Type a name for the column.

behavior.title: Behavior of {column}
behavior.lead: Changes save as you make them and apply to this board only.
behavior.wip_desc: The board's counters at the top add up the tasks in columns marked here.

flags.initial_desc: New tasks land in this column, and a task with unfinished dependencies waits here.
flags.terminal_desc: Tasks in this column count as done and unblock the tasks that depend on them.
flags.auto_advance: Move on when the agent finishes
flags.auto_advance_desc: When the agent's run ends cleanly, the task moves to the next column on its own.
flags.push_branch_desc: A clean run here pushes the task's branch to the repository.
flags.open_pr_desc: A task entering this column opens its pull request.
flags.legacy_desc: Any approval on the task keeps it here, not only the required ones. Turn it off to rely on required approvals.
flags.no_agents: No agent covers this column yet.

locks.initial_move: To change it, make another column the start.
locks.initial_terminal: A finishing column can't be the start.
locks.last_terminal: The board needs at least one finishing column.
locks.terminal_initial: The start column can't also finish work.
locks.terminal_no_advance: A finishing column does not pass the task on.

delete.title: Delete column {column}?
delete.lost: Its behavior and approvals are deleted with it. This can't be undone.

move.picked_kbd: Picked up {column}, position {position} of {count}. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.
move.unchanged: The column stayed where it was.
move.cancelled: Move cancelled. The column is back where it was.

warnings.initial_not_first: Tasks start in {stage}, which is not the first column.
warnings.after_terminal: {stage} comes after {terminal}, where work finishes. Tasks that finish never reach it.

errors.generic: The daemon didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.
